dedupe_keys.name: scinda gnss receiver ionospheric datasets lisbon airport area 2014 to 2019

description: These datasets come from a SCINDA GNSS receiver (NovAtel EURO4 with a JAVAD choke-ring antenna) installed in the Lisbon airport area, which ran from November 2014 to July 2019. The first release holds the full 2015 year in archived raw formats: quality messages, signal-to-noise ratios, pseudoranges and phases, receiver position, scintillation monitor files and ionospheric parameters (TEC, rate of change of TEC, ROTI and the S4 scintillation index) at one-minute resolution per receiver-satellite pair. It adds processed hourly means for March, June, October and December 2015, chosen for their geomagnetic events. A companion data article describes an updated set extending the series to 2019. The data were published by Tatiana Barlyaeva in 2020 under CC BY 4.0 and can be processed with the SCINDA-Iono MATLAB toolbox on MathWorks File Exchange. Caveats: it is a single mid-latitude station, the raw files need the SCINDA formats and toolbox, and gaps exist. It supports assessment of ionospheric effects on GNSS used for aviation approach procedures and timing near an airport during storms; a related record is the NOAA POES and MetOp SEM data.
